name: Freie Universität Berlin
description: Freie Universität Berlin is a public research university in Berlin-Dahlem, founded in 1948. It has about 34,000 students and is part of the Berlin University Alliance funded under Germany's Excellence Strategy.
whyIncluded: Freie Universität Berlin is among the 10 universities in Germany most chosen by international students (international students are 13% of its bachelor's and 33% of its master's students, 34,400 students in winter semester 2024/25), per the FinexisEdu shortlist research of October 2026; its medical degree, taught by Charité, is on the Singapore Medical Council's list.

livingCosts.summary: Freie Universitaet Berlin says to budget at least 934 euros a month for rent, groceries and leisure in Berlin. The university gives no breakdown, so the split into rent, food, transport and personal uses the average shares of other German universities' budgets.
livingCosts.notes: Rung B. FU Berlin page 'How high are the living costs in Berlin?' (published by FU's Cairo Liaison Office on fu-berlin.de): 'You should count on spending a minimum of 934 Euro (rental fees, grocery, leisure time etc.)' per month, tied to the visa proof-of-funds amount. No breakdown is given anywhere on FU's international pages ('Fees & Funding', 'Entry & Residence'), so the 934 was split with the Germany shares .56/.28/.01/.15: housing 523.04, food 261.52, transport 9.34, personal 140.10. Corroboration from FU's own 'Living in Berlin' page: student-housing rent EUR 311-491, average Berlin rent 2024 EUR 678; FU 'Health Insurance' page: statutory student insurance about EUR 120/month (inside the personal share here). Note the 934 figure is the former blocked-account amount; the current German requirement is EUR 992/month. Excluded: semester fee (which includes the semester ticket), deposits, one-off set-up. The repo's hu-berlin entry is a rung-C DAAD entry, not rung A, so it could not serve as a rung-D sister source.

programmes.name: Informatik B.Sc. (Monobachelor)
programmes.summary: No tuition, including for international students. The figure is only the compulsory semester contribution, which includes a Germany-wide transport ticket. Taught in German.
programmes.notes: No tuition fees: FU's 'Fees and Contributions' page states that Freie Universitaet Berlin does not charge any tuition fees (except for continuing education programs). Compulsory fees = semester contribution for winter semester 2026/27, EUR 376.80 x2: Studierendenwerk social contribution 85.00 + administration fee 50.00 + student government (AStA) 10.00 + Deutschlandsemesterticket 226.80 + social fund 5.00. 2025 history: the same page gives summer semester 2026 (part of academic year 2025/26) as EUR 358.80 (administration 50 + Studierendenwerk 85 + student government 10 + ticket incl. social fund 213.80), so 717.60; the winter 2025/26 rate is not on the page, so the summer rate x2 is used (as for HU Berlin). No 2024 figure found. Not on FU's list of English-taught programmes (the only English-taught bachelor's is North American Studies), so taught in German. Listed as a mono-bachelor (B.Sc.) on FU's bachelor's overview. Standard period 6 semesters assumed (not read).

programmes.name: Medizin (Modellstudiengang, Staatsexamen) at Charité – Universitätsmedizin Berlin
programmes.summary: No tuition. The figure is only the compulsory semester fee for students enrolled at Charité with Freie Universität membership, including a Germany-wide transport ticket. Taught in German. Places are nationally restricted.
programmes.notes: Medicine in Berlin is taught by Charité – Universitätsmedizin Berlin, the joint medical faculty of Freie Universität and Humboldt-Universität; students enrol at Charité and choose FU or HU for student-body representation (FU's bachelor's overview lists Medizin under Staatsexamen 'via Charité'). No tuition fees. Compulsory fees = Charité's first-semester enrolment fee for winter semester 2026/27 'mit Wahlrecht an der FU' EUR 376.80 x2 (Charité admissions office sheet; not itemised there; HU variant 381.80). It equals FU's own winter 2026/27 semester contribution. No 2024/2025 figure found for FU-membership Charité students, so no history rows. Undergraduate-entry state examination degree, standard period 12 semesters incl. practical year (as recorded for HU). Admission nationally restricted; non-EU applicants apply via uni-assist. Language of instruction: German. Charité-Universitätsmedizin Berlin, Medizinische Fakultät is on the Singapore Medical Council's list of registrable basic medical qualifications (Medical Registration Act 1997, Second Schedule, Germany section, read on sso.agc.gov.sg 2026-10-07).
